consequence.statement: If the Crossplane core is started with --enable-composition-webhook-schema-validation, v2.0.0 returns the error "Crossplane now uses CEL to validate Compositions. The --enable-composition-webhook-schema-validation flag will be removed in a future release.", so the core does not start until the flag is removed.
consequence.remediation: Remove --enable-composition-webhook-schema-validation from the Crossplane core arguments; Composition validation is now performed with CEL and the flag is scheduled for removal in a future release.

assertion.statement: In v2.0.0 the Crossplane core command returns a new error stating that Crossplane now uses CEL to validate Compositions and that the --enable-composition-webhook-schema-validation flag will be removed in a future release.
